content: स्थायिन् {%a.%} [स्था-णिनि] .²1 Standing, staying, being situated (at the end of <ab>comp.</ab>). .²2 Enduring, continuing, lasting, abiding; शरीरं क्षणविध्वंसि कल्पान्तस्थायिनो गुणाः <ls>Subhāṣ.</ls>; कतिपयदिवसस्थायिनी यौवनश्रीः <ls>Bh. 3. 82</ls>; <ls>Mv. 7. 15</ls>. .²3 Living, dwelling, remaining; संपत्स्यन्ते कतिपयदिनस्थायिहंसा दशार्णाः <ls>Me. 23</ls>. .²4 Permanent, firm, steady, invariable, unchangeable. --{%m.%} A lasting or permanent feeling; (see स्थायिभाव below); स्थायिनोऽर्थे प्रवर्तन्ते भावाः संचारिणो यथा <ls>Śi. 2. 87</ls>. --{%n.%} Anything lasting, a permanent state or condition.
